description: Bigger is better! New 22" wheeled version of Tyson's game changing disc-brake equipped trail beast! We worked with Aussie trail boss and BMX lifer Tyson Jones-Peni on an all-out trail and bowl roasting machine. The Wethepeople Chaos Machine Frame features long and stable geometry, combined with Wethepeople’s legendary frame-building technology making it one of the meanest and toughest rigs in the game. Tyson isn’t scared to go fast and hit the mainline with some serious speed so we equipped his signature steed with mounts for a disc brake (and a regular u-brake) making it the first frame of its kind and perfect for riders needing some upgraded stopping power. From the super long 14"+ chainstay to the unique detailing on the seat stay bridge and head tube, the Chaos Machine frame is one of the most “signature” frames we’ve ever made. Now with internal cable routing for an even cleaner look. PLEASE NOTE: This frame is designed for 22" wheels and will require 22" specific forks, wheels and tire. 20" wheels will fit but will alter geometry. See NOTES for more.

components.description: disc mount for 140-160mm rotor AND u-brake mounts, frame comes with repl. brake hardware
